head: YouTube app icon change spotted in Android beta, with seven icons
dek: YouTube beta 21.47.483 for Android has a hidden "App icon" option under General settings, below Appearance, with seven icons to pick from, The Mobile Indian found after turning it on. Google hasn't announced it.
details: Android Authority first found three of the icons in YouTube 21.41.525 in October: a monochrome play button, a glossy frosting-like one and one with an old CRT screen effect. The newer beta adds four: the original "You Tube" logo, the TV-shaped icon of YouTube's first iPhone app, and two experimental textured designs. It's not known whether it will need YouTube Premium, and features found in test builds may never ship.
where: Hidden in YouTube's Android beta; not available to users yet
means: If you like changing how your home screen looks, YouTube may let you swap its icon for a retro one, but it isn't out.
todo: Nothing to do yet; the option is hidden even in the beta.
